name: Stack
summary: Stack applies consistent vertical rhythm between sibling elements in document order. It supplies geometry only.

semanticModel.rationale: A layout primitive cannot know whether its children form a list, a group, a set of landmarks, or unrelated blocks. Only the consumer knows, so Stack adds no ARIA role, no accessible name, and no state.
consumerObligations: If the children form a list, the consumer MUST supply list semantics on its own markup.
If the children form a labelled group, the consumer MUST supply the grouping role and accessible name.
The consumer MUST NOT rely on Stack to convey any relationship between children.

derivation.rationale: Stack is a flex column on a plain div. No published interaction pattern applies to it, because it has no interaction. The native element and one CSS declaration fully supply the behaviour, so no custom pattern is derived and none is needed.

keyboardContract.statement: Stack has no keyboard contract. It is stated explicitly rather than omitted so that a reviewer cannot mistake absence for oversight.

focusLifecycle.note: Stack never moves, traps, or restores focus. Focus behaviour belongs entirely to its children.

reflowBehaviour.mechanism: A flex column with a gap expressed in rem. The block direction grows with content, so the primitive reflows at any viewport size, zoom level, or root font size without a breakpoint.
reflowBehaviour.exceptionRationale: Stack arranges blocks along one axis and creates no header-to-cell relationship, so no region arranged with Stack may claim the WCAG 1.4.10 two-dimensional exception.

wcagMapping.name: Meaningful Sequence
wcagMapping.note: Visual order follows DOM order because Stack never reorders children.

wcagMapping.name: Reflow
wcagMapping.note: Single-axis flex composition with no author-fixed dimensions, consistent with sufficient technique C31.

wcagMapping.name: Resize Text
wcagMapping.note: The gap is rem-anchored, so spacing grows with the user's text size.

wcagMapping.name: Text Spacing
wcagMapping.note: No fixed heights and no clipping, so user spacing overrides do not truncate content.

wcagMapping.name: Info and Relationships
wcagMapping.note: Stack conveys no relationships. The consumer owns this criterion.

guarantees.statement: The vertical rhythm between sibling children resolves to the value of the space.default token.
The primitive declares no fixed height and no author-fixed dimension other than a hairline border, so user text-spacing overrides cannot cause it to clip content.
The primitive adds no role, no aria-* attribute, and no tabindex to its own element, so it contributes nothing to the accessibility tree.
At 320 CSS pixels of available inline size, and at 400% zoom, the primitive clips no content and produces no page-level horizontal scrollbar.
Spacing grows proportionally with the user's text size, and nothing overlaps when text-spacing overrides are applied.
Visual order matches document order, because the primitive never reorders its children.

nonGuarantees: Stack does not provide list semantics.
Stack does not provide a grouping role or an accessible name.
Stack does not provide a heading structure or landmark.
Stack does not enforce the measure; that is the Center primitive's responsibility.
Stack does not manage focus, focus order, focus trapping, or focus return.
Stack does not guarantee contrast between any pair of colour tokens.
Stack does not provide a basis for claiming the WCAG 1.4.10 two-dimensional exception.

assertions.statement: The computed gap resolves to the value of the space.default token.
assertions.procedure: Read the resolved value of the gap property and compare it with the token value after alias resolution.

assertions.statement: No descendant introduced by the primitive declares a fixed height or an author-fixed dimension other than a hairline border.
assertions.procedure: Inspect the primitive's stylesheet for height, min-height, and px length declarations.

assertions.statement: The primitive adds no role, aria-* attribute, or tabindex to its own element.
assertions.procedure: Assert the rendered element exposes no accessibility-affecting attributes.

assertions.statement: At 320 CSS pixels of available inline size, and at 400% zoom, no content is clipped and no horizontal scrollbar appears at page level.
assertions.procedure: Resize to 1280 by 1024 at 400% zoom and inspect the realistic-page fixture.

assertions.statement: With the root font size doubled and text-spacing overrides applied, spacing grows proportionally and nothing overlaps.
assertions.procedure: Apply the user text-spacing bookmarklet and doubled root font size to the realistic-page fixture.

assertions.statement: Visual order matches DOM order in the realistic-page fixture.
assertions.procedure: Compare a linearised reading of the DOM with the rendered order.

uncertainty.subject: Screen-reader announcement of a bare grouping container
uncertainty.statement: Whether any shipping screen reader announces or otherwise exposes the Stack container element itself has not been tested for this sample.

uncertainty.subject: Interaction of rem-anchored gaps with operating-system font scaling in Electron
uncertainty.statement: The behaviour of rem-anchored gaps under operating-system font scaling inside an Electron shell has not been tested for this sample.

uncertainty.subject: Reflow of a Stack at 320 CSS pixels of available inline size and at 400% zoom
uncertainty.statement: Whether a Stack clips content or produces a page-level horizontal scrollbar at 320 CSS pixels of available inline size, or at 400% zoom, has not been tested for this sample. Assertion stack-a4 states the expected behaviour but is manual, and no observation has been recorded against it.

uncertainty.subject: Voice-driven targeting of content placed inside a Stack
uncertainty.statement: Whether the Stack container interferes with pointer or voice-driven activation of its children has not been tested for this sample. The claim is one of non-interference, because the primitive exposes no operable target of its own.

tests.note: This sample does not ship the story fixtures. The paths record where they belong in a complete package and a consumer MUST treat them as absent here.
